summary: Iteration 5 verifies the two-stage domain-selection fix (STAGE A compact index -> STAGE B full-record reasoning) end-to-end. All 10 backend pytest tests PASS in 124.23s against the public Cloudflare-fronted URL (dev-converse.preview.emergentagent.com), including a full FOUR-turn session (writing -> revise -> answer -> revise) with per-turn <60s elapsed assertions. Backend logs confirm STAGE B reasoner_prompt_bytes ranged 4618..7802 across the 4 turns (comfortably in the ~7KB budget) — the full 13-domain model is NOT being sent every turn. Domain selection shifted across turns (['Opening / Introduction','Audience Awareness'] -> ['Opening / Introduction','Central Claim / Thesis'] -> ['Central Claim / Thesis','Paragraph Purpose']) — not mechanically identical. theory_history grew v1..v4, each snapshot correctly captures the theory BEFORE that turn's update; changes_since_previous transitions off 'initial' after turn 1. Every turn returned currently_relevant_domains as a 1-3 element subset of the 13 canonical names. Exactly ONE student-facing ai-invitation appended per interact (2 candidate_invitations + 1 selected_invitation stored). No stage/level/score/rubric language detected in any invitation or theory blob. AI did not rewrite student text and did not deny the revisions on turns 2 or 4 (turn 4 invitation acknowledged 'You've moved from bullet-like fragments into flowing sentences'). Retry handling: transient failures retry once (~3s) without duplicating student turn or theory history; empty submission -> 400 and missing session -> 404 for GET/POST/PATCH all confirmed. Frontend flow via public URL fully verified with Playwright: TeacherSetup (input-assignment / input-pedagogical_purpose / input-current_writing_task / input-teacher_notes) -> begin-session-button -> StudentWorkspace (writing-area + continue-button on turn 1, reply-mode-revise/answer + reply-input + send-reply-button on turns 2-4). All 4 turns rendered a fresh ai-invitation bubble each. Dev panel (open-dev-panel-button -> development-panel) surfaced 'Currently Relevant Canonical Domains', 'Change From Previous Interaction', 2 candidate-invitation-N cards, and selected-invitation. Teacher telos edit (toggle-telos-editor -> telos-edit-pedagogical_purpose / telos-edit-current_writing_task -> save-telos-button) fired the 'Telos revised' toast and the StudentWorkspace header immediately reflected the new current_writing_task. close-dev-panel-button dismissed the panel. Browser reload restored 4 AI + 4 student bubbles via localStorage dws_session_id.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_build_compact_domain_index / get_relevant_domain_data — STAGE A index carries only domain_name + one-sentence communicative function + relationships (compact); STAGE B retrieves the FULL records by exact name via a dict lookup on _DOMAINS_BY_NAME. No duplication of the canonical model in code; single source of truth is canonical_writing_model.json.

server.py:_select_relevant_domains — STAGE A uses a separate LlmChat with a SELECT-only system message and a JSON-shape reply; validates returned names against _DOMAINS_BY_NAME (drops hallucinated names); retries once (~3s); falls back to prior theory.currently_relevant_domains, then to 'Whole Essay Purpose'. Cap of 3 domains enforced with names[:3].

server.py:interact — STAGE A then STAGE B; the per-turn '[interact] turn domains=[...] reasoner_prompt_bytes=NNNN' log line is emitted BEFORE streaming so future regressions to prompt bloat are directly observable. Verified: bytes ranged 4618-7802 across 4 turns.

server.py:_apply_engine_result — theory_history snapshot correctly captures the previous session.telos/session.theory BEFORE they are replaced; version = len(history)+1. Verified end-to-end for v1..v4: v1 = empty initial theory, v2 = turn-1 theory, v3 = turn-2 theory, v4 = turn-3 theory.

server.py:interact retry loop — one retry on transient/unreadable failure with `: retry\n\n` heartbeat and 3s backoff. The student turn is appended BEFORE the generator runs, so a retry does NOT duplicate it. theory_history is only appended inside _apply_engine_result, called only after a successful parse.
api.js:interact (frontend) — SSE reader parses only `event: done` / `event: error`, ignores `:` heartbeat comments and the STAGE A `: retry` marker; matches backend framing exactly.

SYSTEM_MESSAGE / BREVITY rules — no stage/level/score/rubric language observed across the 4-turn run in invitations, theory, or interactions; 2 candidate_invitations per turn (within the 2-3 allowed range).

rca of the issue: N/A — iteration_5 acceptance passed end-to-end. Two-stage domain selection is functioning as designed: STAGE A LLM call over COMPACT_DOMAIN_INDEX (name + one-sentence function + relationships) picks 1-3 domains; STAGE B assembles the reasoner prompt from ONLY those domains' full records via get_relevant_domain_data(). Measured reasoner_prompt_bytes 4618, 5751, 5878, 7016 across the pytest 4-turn run and 4843, 6165, 6306, 7802 across the Playwright 4-turn run — comfortably under the ~7KB budget with headroom, well below what previously caused 502s at the Cloudflare edge. Each turn completed under 60s (typical 20-40s), theory_history preserved v1..v4 with earlier snapshots intact, and domains legitimately shifted as the writing changed (Opening/Introduction + Audience Awareness -> Opening/Introduction + Central Claim/Thesis -> Central Claim/Thesis + Paragraph Purpose).
